raw_bar_source.source: existing broad raw Yahoo 1h artifact run 34592896202
raw_bar_source.bins: same causal AM_09_13 and PM_13_CLOSE clock bins

signal_features.market_relative_bb_width: same-date + same-bin cross-sectional percentile among prior-day-gated complete bins
signal_features.relative_volume: log1p(current bin volume / median previous20 same-symbol same-bin volumes)
signal_features.prior_high: max high of previous 4 complete chronological bins for same symbol

frozen_signal_rule: at least one of previous 4 complete bins had xrank_bb_width_pct <= 0.30
current close > max(high of previous 4 complete bins)
current log_volume_rel20 >= log(2), equivalent to current same-bin volume >= prior20 same-bin median
rationale: seek a distinct volatility-compression release with price breakout, expansion and participation; no oversold/reversal premise

selection.cooldown: 5 official XTKS sessions per symbol; AM before PM

discovery.rationale: use available pre-2025 raw 4H history first

periods.h2_policy: closed unless discovery and H1 confirmation both pass the same role gate

endpoint: next official XTKS session open to fifth official XTKS session close

decision.if_core_passes: freeze Core role and open only H1 confirmation
decision.if_monster_passes: freeze Monster role and open only H1 confirmation
decision.if_both_pass: report both roles but do not change signal rule
